g.text: Guides you to the answer with questions
▸ 3-layer context: rolling summary + 4-turn window + current message
▸ Cross-session memory via async behavioural snapshots in SQLite
▸ Cloud GPU inference over ngrok with local Ollama fallback
Reads 15–20+ articles a day and keeps
▸ Multi-agent CrewAI flow scoring substance, credibility, learning value
▸ Local Qwen2.5 inference with retry / fallback orchestration
▸ RSS + REST ingestion, dedupe, auto PDF digest over SMTP
▸ RNN / LSTM with Word2Vec embeddings and Byte-Pair Encoding
▸ Accuracy lifted from 88% to 94.6% through model tuning
Flags a drowsy driver live on plain
▸ Eye Aspect Ratio classifier at 94–96% accuracy
▸ Co-authored a research paper on the approach
